reason: a destination's size cap cut this content before it was stored (weft.content.truncated_bytes)
fix: raise the destination's cap: otel.Content(otel.ContentConfig{MaxBytes: …}), -1 for unlimited

log_cap.reason: the app-log reader's cap was reached before attribution: later lines of this run may be missing
log_cap.fix: log less in the run's trace (a busy subagent or sibling run counts too)

metadata_cap.reason: metadata pairs over the core's limits were dropped whole
metadata_cap.fix: send fewer or smaller pairs (weft.Metadata: 64 keys, 128-byte keys, 1 KiB values)

response_cap.reason: the run has more steps than this response reads: the later ones were not compared, nothing was lost
response_cap.fix: open the later steps one by one (runs/{id}/steps/{n})

result_cap.reason: a tool result was cut by its result cap: the model saw a prefix and the marker

reason: content not captured by this app: the destination stripped it (weft.content = stripped) or the agent captured none (weft.Content(false), weft.content = none) — prompts, catalogs, messages, tool arguments and results were dropped before storage
fix: turn content on: drop otel.NoContent() from the destination, or weft.Content(false) from the agent

reason: the destination's Redact hook rewrote this content before it was stored
the step finished on the output token limit: the response was cut
the run stopped reporting: no finish arrived and nothing was heard from it for over 30 s
a record the run counts is missing: a destination dropped it on the way
fix: raise the destination's queue: otel.QueueSize(n) (Studio's default 16,384), or otel.Blocking() under WEFT_ENV=dev (or otel.DevMode()); the app's WARN "weft/otel: destination queue full" names it, weft doctor the drops (weft.records.dropped)

events_lost.reason: more event records were emitted than stored (weft.run.events on the root span): a destination dropped them, its queue full or an export failed
events_lost.fix: raise the destination's queue: otel.QueueSize(n) (Studio's default 16,384), or otel.Blocking() under WEFT_ENV=dev (or otel.DevMode()); the app's WARN "weft/otel: destination queue full" names it, weft doctor the drops (weft.records.dropped)

messages_lost.reason: more transcript batches were emitted than stored (weft.run.messages on the root span): a destination dropped them, its queue full or an export failed — messages are missing
messages_lost.fix: raise the destination's queue: otel.QueueSize(n) (Studio's default 16,384), or otel.Blocking() under WEFT_ENV=dev (or otel.DevMode()); the app's WARN "weft/otel: destination queue full" names it, weft doctor the drops (weft.records.dropped)

tail_lost.reason: the run's root span ended but its run_finish record never arrived: a destination dropped the record tail, so the last steps' records are missing
tail_lost.fix: raise the destination's queue: otel.QueueSize(n) (Studio's default 16,384), or otel.Blocking() under WEFT_ENV=dev (or otel.DevMode()); the app's WARN "weft/otel: destination queue full" names it, weft doctor the drops (weft.records.dropped)

reason: the weft that wrote this run kept no such record (v0.9.0 or earlier keeps no request, prompt or tools records, ADR 0028): nothing was lost

no_logger.reason: the app exported spans only: they arrived, none of its records did — no events, transcript or request records
no_logger.fix: wire the logs too: pass weft.LoggerProvider(lp) beside weft.TracerProvider, or use otel.Install (it wires both)

no_public_id.reason: the session's turns carry no weft.public_id (the session was created without thread.PublicID)
no_public_id.fix: thread.Create(…, thread.PublicID(id)), or set weft.public_id on every turn

no_spans.reason: the run was recorded without a tracer: no attempt spans, no answering model

not_served.reason: this Studio does not serve the request record (no requests capability): the run may hold one
not_served.fix: use a Studio that serves it (upgrade it, or enable the requests group)

raw_off.reason: no wire bodies recorded for this attempt: otel.RawBodies is off (the default; refused outside WEFT_ENV=dev or otel.DevMode()) or the adapter does not report them
raw_off.fix: run under WEFT_ENV=dev (or otel.DevMode()) with otel.RawBodies(true) and a first-party adapter (an injected google client is not captured)

reason: computed by the reader, not stored as emitted: the record that would say it is absent

stock_spans.fix: stock OTel GenAI spans carry no weft events or request records: set OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=true for the messages and tool arguments (Studio reads them from the span attributes) and gen_ai.conversation.id on the invoke_agent span for a session (docs/record-contract.md §9); weft's own records need a weft SDK (Go today)

reason: your token's access does not reach this: a read-only panel token reads no system prompt or tool catalog

dev_token_only.reason: a panel token reads its one public id, never a session's: this route answers the dev token only
dev_token_only.fix: ask with the server (dev) token, or use the public id the panel token was minted for

reason: the model saw a compacted view: compaction replaced part of the transcript for this request
